'''Danz Borin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] who worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. He tracked down the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Milliennium Falcon]]'', to collect the bounty on Solo from Jabba. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] inside [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], Borin nearly captured the bounty, before bounty hunter [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] attempted to and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Solo.

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] Danz Borin was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|86|Borin, Danz}}</ref> and [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]<ref name="CCG" /> who worked for the<ref name="FF22" /> [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]<ref name="FF22" /> and maintained a residence<ref name="CSWE" /> on the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Danz Borin}}</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="CSWE" /> He tracked down the<ref name="CSWE" /> Human [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]<ref name="Han Solo SWE">{{SWE|characters|hansolo|Han Solo}}</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]<ref name="Workshop Manual">''[[Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual]]''</ref> ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', to collect the bounty on Solo from Jabba.<ref name="CSWE" /> 

[[File:HanChillinAtChalmuns-ANH.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Borin tracked down and sought to collect the bounty on Han Solo (pictured).]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Borin was on the<ref name="ANH" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="ANH" /> in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]],<ref name="Mos Eisley">{{DB|location|moseisley|Mos Eisley}}</ref> seeking to collect on the bounty.<ref name="FF22" /> The bounty hunter, cup in hand, talked with a [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suited]] individual then went to the bar of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] as the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] entered the cantina, searching for a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to take them and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="ANH" /> 

When the droids were ordered out by the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]], Borin sat in a booth and talked with another flight suited individual. A [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerian]]<ref name="ANH" /> and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Neesh/Legends|Neesh]]<ref name="SWFC">{{ForceCollection|Neesh|star=2}}</ref> also sat with them.<ref name="ANH" /> The bounty hunter and the flight suited individual looked in the direction of Skywalker and Kenobi when they got into a dispute with the criminals [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]].<ref name="Complete Locations" /> Borin was about to claim the bounty on Solo but before he did, the Rodian bounty hunter [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], who was also employed by Jabba, beat him to it.<ref name="CSWE" /> Borin counted himself fortunate<ref name="FF22" /> as just a [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] later, Greedo was<ref name="CSWE" /> easily<ref name="FF22" /> [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Solo.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Personality and traits==
Borin had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="ANH" /> He was cocky<ref name="CSWE" /> and nearly as good as he boasted, to his companions' delight.<ref name="CCG" />

==Equipment==
Borin wore a white flight suit and a white helmet while at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Danz Borin first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The Cantina scenes that featured Borin, portrayed by [[Chris Bunn]],<ref name="FanthaTracks">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/conventions-events/echo-live-bespin-bazaar-saturday-1st-october-2022-new-guest-announcements|text=Echo Base Live Bespin Bazaar: Saturday 1st October 2022: New guest announcements|author=Bayliss, Carl|date=2022-08-24|archivedate=20220824121706}}</ref> were shot at [[Shepperton Studios]] between [[April 12]] and [[April 22]], [[1976]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> Borin was first identified with a card released in [[A New Hope Limited]],<ref name="CCG" /> the [[1996]]<ref name="A New Hope Limited">{{InsiderCite|31|Pick a Card, Any Card: Making Movie Magic at Decipher, Inc.}}</ref> expansion set to [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" />
